pli-tv-kd17:1.1.10: pana → yu. ma. rā. potthakesu panasaddo na dissati.
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.23: va → yu. akhīṇeyeva. | mātāpitaro → yu. ma. pitaro.
pli-tv-kd17:1.2.28: amma → yu. ma. rā. potthakesu ammāti na dissati.
pli-tv-kd17:1.3.11: vā → yu. ma. rā. potthakesu vāsaddo na dissati.
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.1: ca → yu. bhagu ca kimbilo ca.
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.20: nivatto → yu. yaṃpi na nivatto. ma. yaṃpi nivatto.
pli-tv-kd17:1.4.21: kho → yu. ma. potthakesu khosaddo na dissati.
pli-tv-kd17:1.6.10: eko → yu. ma. potthakesu ayaṃ saddo natthi. | viharāmīti → yu. potthake itisadado natthi.
pli-tv-kd17:2.3.3: ca → yu. ma. potthakesu ayaṃ casaddo na paññāyati.
pli-tv-kd17:3.1.1: sarājikāya → ito paraṃ yu. ma. potthakesu parisāyāti pāṭho dissati.
pli-tv-kd17:3.10.18: parinibbāyanti → yu. ma. rā. anupakkamena bhikkhave tathāgatā parinibbāyanti.
pli-tv-kd17:3.11.14: pharuso → yu. ma. potthakesu pharusoti na paññāyati.
pli-tv-kd17:3.13.19: bhindeyyunti → yu. ma. mā pāpicchā pakkhaṃ nissāya saṅghaṃ bhindeyyuṃ.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.8: santuṭṭhatāya → yu. santuṭṭhiyā. | dhūtāya → yu. dhutatāya.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.14: vatthūni → yu. ma. potthakesu idaṃ padadvayaṃ na dissati.
pli-tv-kd17:3.14.15: ca → yu. ma. potthakesu casaddo na dissati.
pli-tv-kd17:4.1.21: hoti → yu. ma. potthakesu bhagavato avidūre rodamāno ṭhito hotīti pāṭho āgato.
pli-tv-kd17:4.5.4: ca → ayaṃ casaddo yu. ma. potthakesu na dissati. | saṅkhāditvā → ma. saṅgharitvā.
pli-tv-kd17:4.5.7: nāgā → idaṃ nāgāti vacanaṃ yu. ma. potthakesu na dissati.
pli-tv-kd17:4.6.14: kuppati → yu. ma. pucchito ca na kuppati.
pli-tv-kd17:5.2.21: apakassanti → yu. apakāsanti. | uposathaṃ → yu. ma. āveṇiuposathaṃ.
